This device is charging from the computer but gets no data over the cable, which is why adb devices shows nothing. The cable is most likely charge only. Use the cable that came with your phone or another data cable, and plug it straight into the computer instead of a hub or a front panel port.

The computer is connected, but USB debugging is not active on this connection. Pull down the notifications, tap the USB notification and pick File transfer, or unplug the cable and plug it back in. Tap to open Developer options.

Connected, and USB debugging is active on this device. If adb devices shows unauthorized or nothing at all, unlock this device and tap Allow on the Allow USB debugging prompt. No prompt? In Developer options, tap Revoke USB debugging authorizations, then unplug and plug in again. On Windows the phone may also need its USB driver. Tap for the driver guide.

Use WiFi instead of a cable. Turn on Wireless debugging and tap Pair device with pairing code. On the computer, run these with the ports and code from that screen, then run the start command below. Tap to open Developer options.\nadb pair %1$s:PORT CODE\nadb connect %1$s:PORT

Use WiFi instead of a cable. This Android version has no Wireless debugging, so plug in the cable once and run adb tcpip 5555, unplug it, then run this and the start command below.\nadb connect %1$s:5555
Connect this device to WiFi to use adb without a cable. The computer must be on the same network.

Voidstrap for Android is built around root. Android locks Roblox\'s files away from every other app, and root is what lets Voidstrap write to them, so most features depend on it.
Swaps Roblox\'s own files for your mods. This only works with root.
Writes your flags to the file Roblox reads every time it starts.
Sees which game you join, for your Discord status, join notifications and your library.

No root? The Voidstrap helper can be started once from a computer on the next step. It runs FastFlags and activity tracking until the phone restarts, but mods always need root. Voidstrap only uses root for these things and never reads other apps\' data.
